top_signals.title: US cancels joint marine drills with South Korea over Iran war-related force constraints
top_signals.summary: The United States canceled a joint amphibious landing drill scheduled for next month with South Korea due to force availability.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Protolabs Rides Manufacturing Momentum
top_signals.summary: US manufacturing is getting a boost from growing demand across defense, aerospace and drones. Protolabs is tapping into that demand, using digital manufacturing to produce custom parts in as little as a day. CEO Suresh Krishna discusses the opportunity on Bloomberg Open Interest. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.
